body:
I've found what looks like a file handle leak when batch-developing Canon CR3 files on Windows.

## Environment
- ART 1.26.8, official Windows build (also reproduced with my own MSYS2/UCRT64 build of 1.26.8)
- Windows 10, photos on a local NTFS SSD
- Canon CR3 files (about 68 files in one folder)
- Not sure about other raw file types, as I only have a Canon camera.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open a folder containing ~68 CR3 files
2. Select all (Ctrl+A) and put them in the processing queue (processing includes denoise, etc.)
3. During/after processing, ART starts failing with filesystem errors:
   - images can no longer be loaded
   - "Warning! Unable to save your preferences to: ..."
4. Restarting ART fixes it (until the next batch)

## Evidence of the leak
I inspected the process with Sysinternals handle.exe while the error was occurring.
The same CR3 files are held open many times over,
e.g. IMG_4308.CR3 appears 5 times below, and most files in the folder have ~10 open handles each.
With ~68 files that exceeds the default Windows CRT limit of 512 descriptors.

12A4: File          D:\raw\IMG_4308.CR3
12B0: File          D:\raw\IMG_4308.CR3
12B4: File          D:\raw\IMG_4307.CR3
12D4: File          D:\raw\IMG_4307.CR3
12E0: File          D:\raw\IMG_4308.CR3
12E4: File          D:\raw\IMG_4333.CR3
12F4: File          D:\raw\IMG_4317.CR3
12FC: File          D:\raw\IMG_4327.CR3
1300: File          D:\raw\IMG_4307.CR3
1320: File          D:\raw\IMG_4313.CR3
1344: File          D:\raw\IMG_4308.CR3
1354: File          D:\raw\IMG_4308.CR3
136C: File          D:\raw\IMG_4307.CR3

I also added a debug log to rtgui\options.cc like below:
std::cout << "Warning! Unable to save your preferences to: " << fname
          << "  errno=" << err
          << " (" << g_strerror(err) << ")"
          << std::endl;

Then got the following output:
Warning! Unable to save your preferences to: C:\...\AppData\Local\ART\options  errno=24 (Too many open files)

## Additional observations
- If I export the same files as JPEG *without any processing*, the problem does NOT occur.
  It only happens when processing (e.g. denoise) is applied.
  So the leak seems to be in the processing pipeline rather than in thumbnailing/metadata.
- As a workaround, I rebuilt ART with _setmaxstdio(8192) added at the top of main(), and the symptoms disappear.
title: Potential file handle leak when batch-processing CR3 files, "Too many open files" (errno=24) on 1.26.8 Windows
